mappings.product_miss: The canonical base scenario already knew that recurring disability-related extra costs should lead to adult additional-cost support, but the public product had no focused natural-language path, no payer/double-compensation boundary and no normalized adult support record.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Extend the same root/person product with focus=adult_extra_costs. Ask only whether the cost is genuinely extra because of disability, who pays it and the age/study applicant boundary. Keep ordinary spending, other-public-payer overlap and 18–20 study status explicit, and send the user to the current Försäkringskassan source without calculating entitlement or amount.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Försäkringskassan is the truth-bearing primary source. Diagnosis alone is not entitlement, total spending is not the same as assessed additional costs, a cost already paid by municipality/region/assistansersättning cannot be counted again unchanged, and the normalized support record remains NEEDS_REVIEW with no material fields verified.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not put diagnosis, exact costs, receipts, municipality/region, identity, school name or raw situation text in URL or structured feedback. Feedback carries only language, route and product ratings.
